summary: This 8-K, filed on July 16, 2026, reports the July 10, 2026 consummation of Columbus Circle Capital Corp III's IPO of 23 million units at $10.00 per unit, generating $230 million in gross proceeds. Simultaneously, the company completed a private placement of 665,000 private units to sponsor and underwriters, raising $6.65 million. Proceeds were deposited into a trust account. This is a routine post-IPO filing, not a special situation; it discloses the IPO's closing and audited balance sheet. No deal, activist, or restructuring is involved.
